name: Woman Communication
original_name: ウーマンコミュニケーション
source:
[i]Welcome to the world of inadvertent lewd language adventures![/i]
It often happens that lewd words are inadvertently made up in conversation, doesn't it? This game is probably the world's first adventure game where you will find such "inadvertent lewd words" to advance the game!

[b]High-speed lewd word action.[/b]
Find the lewd words quickly from the nonstop stream of words on the screen!
Your score is determined by the number, speed and accuracy of the words you find.
This is a unique game system that offers thrilling action.

[b]It doesn't end with just a silly game. A surprising and moving multi-end story![/b]
The story begins when you join the Public Discipline Committee.
You will be the newest member of the Public Discipline Committee, and you will be in charge of controlling the "careless and lewd language" that infests the school and its surroundings.
What's the point of doing that?

And this game has multiple endings. Why does such a stupid game have multiple endings? You may be wondering why such a silly game has multiple endings. Depending on your actions, your future will change in various ways. I wish you the best ending.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095090/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]欢迎来到不经意的淫秽语言冒险世界！[/i]
谈话中不经意间编出猥亵词语的情况时常发生，不是吗？这款游戏可能是世界上第一款你会发现这种“不经意的猥亵言语”来推进游戏的冒险游戏！

[b]高速猥亵言语动作。[/b]
从屏幕上源源不断的文字中快速找到淫秽文字！
你的分数取决于你找到的单词的数量、速度和准确性。
这是一个独特的游戏系统，提供惊心动魄的动作。

[b]它并不仅仅以一场愚蠢的游戏结束。一个令人惊讶又感人的多结局故事！[/b]
故事从你加入公共纪律委员会开始。
你将成为公共纪律委员会的最新成员，你将负责控制充斥学校及其周围的“粗心和猥亵语言”。
这样做有什么意义呢？

而且这个游戏有多个结局。为什么这么愚蠢的游戏会有多个结局？你可能想知道为什么这样一个愚蠢的游戏有多个结局。根据你的行动，你的未来将会以各种方式改变。祝你有最好的结局。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095090/_/]Steam[/url]]
